# OrderedList

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a sequence of items with generated numeric or alphabetic markers.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ListElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new OrderedList(options?: OrderedListOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`items`](#items): The text items, in order, not counting nested lists.
- [`numberFormat`](#numberformat): Numbering style.
- [`startNumber`](#startnumber): Starting number for the list (default: 1)

### `items`

```typescript
readonly items: readonly string[]
```

*read-only*

The text items, in order, not counting nested lists. Add items with `addItem`.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`. To add one, call `addItem()`.

### `numberFormat`

```typescript
numberFormat: NumberFormat
```

Numbering style. Accepts `'decimal' | 'upper-roman' | 'lower-roman' | 'upper-alpha' | 'lower-alpha'`.

Example, from `industry-templates/people-hr/employment-contract`:

```typescript
list.numberFormat = NumberFormat.Decimal;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
decimalList.numberFormat = ListNumberFormat.Decimal;
```

### `startNumber`

```typescript
startNumber: number
```

Starting number for the list (default: 1)

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
customStartList.startNumber = 5;
```

## Methods

- [`addItem`](#additem): Adds a text item to this list
- [`addNestedList`](#addnestedlist): Adds a nested list to this list
- [`getNestedLists`](#getnestedlists): Child lists rendered as nested list content.

### `addItem`

```typescript
addItem(item: string): void
```

Adds a text item to this list

Example:

```typescript
const list = new OrderedList({ numberFormat: NumberFormat.LowerRoman });
list.addItem('Preliminaries');
list.addItem('Main text');
```

### `addNestedList`

```typescript
addNestedList(nestedList: OrderedList): void
```

Adds a nested list to this list

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
mainOrdered.addNestedList(nestedAlpha);
```
